title: vcocena
text: vcocena provides packaged, runnable version Vertical CoCena² multi‑omics pipeline, plus plotting helpers. horizontal integration (hCoCena) combines several datasets measured one platform, vertical integration combines different omics layers — RNA‑seq microarray, transcriptome chromatin accessibility. pipeline builds co‑expression network per layer, clusters , correlates clusters across layers, merges everything one integrated network modules.

text: bundled example 100‑gene subset intended smoke test; variance range narrow meaningful modules. Use check install, judge results.
code: library(vcocena)  ex <- vcocena_example()  # vcocena_example() points into the installed package library, which is usually # read-only. run_vcocena() creates its save_folder inside working_directory and # writes plots there, so copy the example somewhere writable first. wd <- file.path(tempdir(), "example_vertical") dir.create(wd, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE) file.copy(list.files(ex$working_directory, full.names = TRUE), wd, recursive = TRUE)  out <- run_vcocena(   working_directory = wd,   layers = list(     set1 = c(ex$counts_seq,   ex$anno_seq),     set2 = c(ex$counts_array, ex$anno_array)   ),   supplement   = c(ex$tf, ex$hallmark, ex$go, ex$kegg, ex$reactome),   layers_names = c("sequencing", "microarray"),   save_folder  = "out_v1",   layer_top_var             = c(100, 100),   layer_min_corr            = c(0.2, 0.2),   layer_range_cutoff_length = c(10, 10),   data_in_log               = TRUE )

title: vcocena
text: Automatic cutoff selection stringent. published dataset, choose_auto_cutoff() selected 0.984/0.991 original authors chosen 0.707/0.693 hand diagnostic plots — retaining 878 entities instead 3,405. Inspect cutoff_plot() consider passing cutoff_vec explicitly rather relying automatic choice. Module counts match analyses run ~2024. igraph 2.0 rewrote community detection. identical network, cluster_louvain returns 6 communities igraph 1.2.6 returned 147. Re‑running older CoCena analysis current igraph yields coarser modules; entities scatter, merge. run_vcocena() takes count matrices, one per layer. layers hCoCena integrations across several datasets, entry point accept — design Carraro et al. 2022, needs hCoCena stage first. docker/run_paper.R docker/run_paper_integration.R check package Carraro et al., eLife 2022 using authors’ saved R environment ground truth. vertical‑integration stage reproduces published network exactly: 3,405 nodes, 186,723 edges, 35,453 cross‑layer edges.

title: Run the Vertical CoCena² pipeline — run_vcocena
text: working_directory Path project directory contains data/, sample_info/, reference_files/. layers Named list describing omics layers. entry character vector length 2: c(count_file, annotation_file). supplement Character vector length 5 file names (paths relative reference_files/) TF list, Hallmark, GO, KEGG, Reactome GMT files. layers_names Character vector name layer layers (used plots summaries). save_folder Name output folder (created inside working_directory) plots intermediate files saved. layer_top_var Numeric vector (length = number layers) number top variable genes/entities consider per layer, "". layer_min_corr Numeric vector minimum correlation used start cutoff search per layer. layer_range_cutoff_length Integer vector number cutoffs test layer_min_corr maximum observed correlation per layer. print_distribution_plots Logical; whether save distribution plots tested cutoffs. cutoff_vec Optional numeric vector final correlation cutoffs (one per layer). NULL, automatically chosen via choose_auto_cutoff(). sep_counts Separator count files. sep_anno Separator annotation files. gene_symbol_col Column name count tables contains gene symbols. sample_col Column name annotation tables contains sample IDs. count_has_rn Logical; count file already row names? anno_has_rn Logical; annotation file already row names? voi Character; "variable interest" column annotation tables used define groups Group Fold Change calculation. control Character; name control group, "none". organism Character; organism name used downstream enrichment. min_nodes_number_for_cluster Integer; minimum cluster size retain. min_nodes_number_for_network Integer; minimum connected-component size counted "network" scoring correlation cutoffs. Previously unset, made network count always zero silently degraded automatic cutoff selection; 40 matches original pipeline default. data_in_log Logical; input already log-transformed? Set TRUE rlog/VST/log2 data, otherwise Group Fold Changes wrong. range_GFC Numeric; Group Fold Changes clamped +/- value. identicals_min_corr Numeric; minimum cluster--cluster correlation two clusters different layers treated "identical". cross_corr_threshold Numeric NULL. Cutoff applied cross-layer entity correlations building integrated edge list. NULL (default) selects automatically cutoff highest mixture score; supply number pin , e.g. reproduce published analysis. cross_corr_scan_n Integer; number cutoffs scanned find_cross_corr_cutoff(). cross_corr_scan_min Numeric; lower bound scan.
